panels.title: Battery & Interface Card Temps — CONFIRMED (linear-fit R² > 0.998 vs HEX20 dashboard)

targets.query:

panels.title: Beacon Packet Counter

targets.query:
from(bucket: "koyo_telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "koyo" and r._field == "packet_counter")
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Packet Counter"})

panels.description: Not a simple beacon tally: across 19 confirmed reboots, always resets to 49160-51137 (never near 0), clustering around 0xC000=49152, then climbs as high as 65486 before the next reboot. Likely a flash/EEPROM write-pointer rather than a packet count. See CLAUDE.md oddity #3.
